about_item: Long Press Function and Motion Sensor: Unlike the old version, LHKNL headlamp has added a long press function. Just hold the key mode button for 3 seconds to turn off from any lighting mode—no need to cycle through all modes. It also added motion sensor mode, you can easily turn the lights ON or OFF by waving your hand, which is more convenient and avoids soiling the headlamp when your hands are dirty

Super Bright and Rechargeable: The headlamp flashlight camping essentials uses class-leading LED chips that will provide 2X brighter high lumens, easily light up an entire tent and road. It has powerful rated 1500mAh built-in rechargeable battery, which can be able to charge and turn on the lights at the same time. No need to wait for full charge or replace the battery. And the battery indicator will help you master battery usage. Last for 4-10 hours when fully charged

Ultra-light and Adjustable: The hand-free headlamp is only weight 1.87 OZ, comfortable and lightweight. The lamp head can be rotated 60° and tightly fixed to avoid shaking and sliding when running. The head flashlight uses comfortable elastic headband, which can easily adjust the length to perfectly fit your head size, perfect for adults and kids

Waterproof and 8 Modes: The headlight has IPX4 waterproof rate. The high-quality shell is more sealed and leak-proof, which is suitable for rain or snow, indoors or outdoors. The led headlamp has 8 lighting modes to meet your various needs. In key light mode, you can switch the main strong beam, main weak beam, side strong beam, side weak beam, red beam, SOS red strobe. In motion sensor mode, you can switch the main strong beam and side strong beam

authors_reviews.title: Decent set for general use in dark or dimly lit areas.
authors_reviews.text: Not bad for strap on lights. I like the idea that you can swivel the light downward so you don’t crane your neck or eyeballs while focusing on what you’re working on. The thing I don’t like is you cannot use the main beam and the sidelights at the same time. Might drain the battery faster I don’t know but I was looking for a band that had that option. Main light or sidelight or everything on at the same time. Still not bad and you have the comfort knowing if you wear one down you have three backups while that one recharges. The flashing red I have no idea unless I find myself on a highway and want to warn traffic other than that ?? Still a solid set for general purpose working in a dark area and not having to hold a wrench in one hand and a flashlight in the other.
authors_reviews.author: JeorgeK

authors_reviews.title: Battery life is great
authors_reviews.text: This was a great value, the strap is good, the tilt is good, the battery indicator is really nice, the multiple modes are really nice. The brightness is good, so far, it doesn't seem to get dim as the battery depletes. I have not had any issues with light going off and some mentioned in reviews. I think I would rather have a second button to cycle thru modes instead of the power button to make on and off faster but, small preference that I can live with since everything else is pretty good. The value is great considering I got two of them.
authors_reviews.author: Nick Page

authors_reviews.title: Wonderful! I highly recommend!
authors_reviews.text: We love these! We use headlamps on the farm when it's dark and there's nothing worse than realizing your headlamp batteries are dead. Not a problem with these! And the charge lasts a while too, I'm not charging them every single day. My husband and son also used them when they went catfishing and they used them for hours without them dying. They're comfortable on the head, adjustable, small and light weight so you can throw it in your pocket if needed.
authors_reviews.author: JKFaulkner

authors_reviews.title: Extremely bright
authors_reviews.text: Awesome light! Very very bright and and easy to use. I used it 2:00 AM today to take the the dog out. The dog was on full alert for something. I put the light on and could see a very long distance. No bears, foxes or other preditors. Dog calmed down when she saw nothing. Excellent price and is well made.
authors_reviews.author: Marcus

authors_reviews.title: Works well

Because the light is right where you are looking it's actually better than shop lights. Nice having the option for the super bright spotlight or the other diffuse lights for a wider area close up.

other_countries_reviews.title: Fantastic Light with best Battery life
other_countries_reviews.text: Waited to write a review until I had properly used it on a multiple hour job. Used it at night to do some work on my car at 5am pitch black. It’s so bright that I use it on the low setting for the spot light. After using it non stop for 5 hours straight it still had 3/4 charge left. Absolutely amazing product. The low/high spotlight, low/high floodlight and red light is perfect for a variety of settings. The angle tilt down adjustability is perfect for my eyes when i’m looking down no more neck pain. The strap is easy to use and comfortable. The fact they give you two is amazing since I can charge one if needed and use the other. Charging with usb is great too, keep them charged in my car while driving no need to carry around batteries. Best product ever. If you’re looking for a gift for your DIYer mechanic car guy husband or boyfriend this is what you need to gift him. I’ve been using this for everything ever since I got it. Even just to load my trunk at night I put the head light on. No longer do you need to rely on your friend to hold the light properly!
